llm_verdict.message:
The remediation has been applied:

* Commented out the existing `net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects` line in `/etc/sysctl.d/50-libreswan.conf`.
* Added the required persistent line `net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0` to `/etc/sysctl.d/99-disable-icmp-redirects.conf`.
* Set the runtime value with `sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects=0`.

The host now disables ICMP redirects for all IPv4 interfaces both now and after reboot, satisfying the OpenSCAP rule.

reasoning_messages.content:
The required remediation has been completed:

* **Existing conflicting entry** in `/etc/sysctl.d/50-libreswan.conf` was commented out.
* A persistent configuration file `/etc/sysctl.d/99-disable-icmp-redirects.conf` now contains the line  

  `net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0`
* The kernel parameter was set for the current session with  

  `sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects=0`

The system now disables ICMP redirect acceptance on all IPv4 interfaces both at runtime and across reboots, satisfying the OpenSCAP rule `sysctl_net_ipv4_conf_all_accept_redirects`.
